description: Free, open-source AI Office suite: Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF, Markdown and HTML editors with a built-in AI agent, plus a `genoffice` CLI and agent skill so Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can create and edit real .docx/.xlsx/.pptx files locally. Bring your own key. macOS, Windows & Linux.

summary.one_liner: GenOffice is a free, open-source desktop office suite for macOS, Windows and Linux with Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF, Markdown and HTML editors, a built-in AI agent, and a genoffice CLI/MCP server for coding agents.
summary.what_it_does: Opens and saves native .docx, .xlsx and .pptx files, edits PDF (text edited in place), Markdown and HTML, and places an AI agent beside each document that makes tracked changes, diffs with rollback, or live spreadsheet formulas. Unedited parts of an Office file are copied byte-for-byte on save. A local SQLite full-text index searches the names and contents of files in your folders, with optional reranking by the TypeSafe Jev model. Ask AI answers questions across starred files and cites sources. The genoffice command line and agent skill (plus an MCP server) let coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor create, convert, read and edit Office files headlessly. Conversions such as PDF to Word and Markdown to Word run on-device, and only AI calls leave the machine, to the provider you choose (Genspark sign-in or your own key).
use_cases: edit Word, Excel or PowerPoint files without Microsoft Office
convert PDF to Word, Excel or PowerPoint locally
let a coding agent generate real .docx, .xlsx or .pptx files
AI-assisted editing of spreadsheets with live formulas
search and ask questions across a folder of documents with sources
build a slide deck from a prompt
write and edit Markdown notes with wiki links
how_to_run: Download the installer for your platform from the Releases page (macOS .dmg, Windows -x64.exe or -arm64.exe, Linux .deb/.rpm/.AppImage)
Install the agent skill: npx skills add genspark-ai/genoffice
Claude Code MCP: claude mcp add --transport stdio genoffice -- genoffice mcp
From a source checkout: npm install, then npm run dev
Run tests: npm test; typecheck: npm run typecheck
stack: Rust (xlsx sidecar using calamine and IronCalc)
notable: Byte-preserving OOXML save: only edited blocks are rewritten, all other zip entries copied unchanged
genoffice CLI and MCP server expose the same engines to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents without opening a window
PDF text editing rewrites the page content stream with original fonts rather than adding cover annotations
Hide selected text from the AI app via named placeholders while keeping the original words in the file
Fully local file conversion and on-device full-text search, with optional cloud reranking off by default
caveats: AI features need a network connection and either a Genspark sign-in or your own model API key
Scanned-page OCR in PDF conversion uses system OCR and is stated only for macOS and Windows
Some MCP features (render, PDF conversion) need the app installed and, on a headless host, a virtual display such as xvfb-run
